description: Get the content of a course page as it was at one past revision, with the editor and date. Read-only. The body is fenced as untrusted text. Use list_page_revisions to find revision numbers, and get_page_content for the current version. Canvas returns a permission error if page history is hidden from students.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

page_url.description: The page's URL slug, e.g. "week-1-overview" (the last part of the page address). Get it from list_pages.

revision_id.description: Revision number of the page, from list_page_revisions.

name: get_page_revision
title: Get Page Revision
